lines.en: I walk slowly at the end of the corridor.
The tube light flickers overhead.

lines.zh: 草地被我踩过，却不见痕。
lines.en: I cross the grass and leave no mark.

lines.zh: 这具身体借了一个名字。
lines.en: This body borrowed a name.

lines.zh: 我从阴影走到另一处阴影。
lines.en: I move from one shadow to the next.
My shadow reached that wall first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，数着你的心跳。
lines.en: Step by step, I count your heartbeats.
This corridor is the wrong length.

lines.zh: 我每次回头，路都变了一点。
lines.en: Each time I look back, the path has changed.
Moonlight turns me grey.
I pass a broken lamp.
My steps stop at the door.

lines.zh: 我的脖子歪着，像断了线。
lines.en: My neck hangs crooked, as if its string snapped.
There's light moving in my eyes.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，安静得不对。
lines.en: It's too quiet here. Wrongly quiet.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有人在叫。
lines.en: I hear someone calling far away.
That voice isn't mine.
I lift my face to the tube light.
There's a new crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 我低着头，嘴角一点点咧开。
lines.en: Head low, my grin slowly widens.

lines.zh: 裂缝里也有东西在看我。
lines.en: Something in the crack looks back.
My smile splits slightly, baring teeth.

lines.zh: 这个维度的空气是坏的。
lines.en: The air in this dimension is wrong.

lines.zh: 月光下，我站着一动不动。
lines.en: Under the moonlight I stand motionless.
The hum of the lights is dropping.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在墙上不动。
lines.en: My shadow clings to the wall, still.
You said my name.
You shouldn't have.
Does this face look familiar?
It wasn't mine to begin with.

lines.zh: 你的影子里，多了一个我。
lines.en: A second shape of me joins your shadow.

lines.zh: 暗处是我的地方，你站错了。
lines.en: The dark is mine; you stand in the wrong place.
I can wait much longer.
Your breaths are getting shorter.

lines.zh: 这名字念出来会招东西。
lines.en: Saying that name draws things.
And you already said it.
I hear footsteps behind you.
Don't turn around.
Turn, and you'll see me.
I've been on your left all along.
And on your right as well.
Your shadow looks wrong.
It moves before you do.
I don't need to touch you.
You've started counting the lights.
The moon is on my side.

lines.zh: 你的手穿进去，什么也没摸到。
lines.en: Your hand passes through and finds nothing.

lines.zh: 我的手从影子里抽回来。
lines.en: My hand draws back out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 疼这个字在这儿没有意思。
lines.en: Pain means nothing here.
You said the name again.
The corridor got shorter.
The crack in the wall closed.

lines.zh: 你以为这样就能赶我走。
lines.en: You think that drives me off.
One light came back on.
That was unexpected.
The blade passes through and I smile.

lines.zh: 我对你手里的东西没兴趣。
lines.en: I've no interest in your little trinket.
Food isn't needed here.
Your fingers keep trembling.
Put it down, then leave.
I don't eat. I only watch.
Keeping it won't help you.
This corridor will take it.

lines.zh: 别听那个声音，它在学我。
lines.en: Do not listen to that voice; it is imitating me.
That isn't me speaking.
It's your name.
Your shoulder brushed my shadow.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的肩膀先僵了。
lines.en: Hit me, and your shoulder stiffens first.

lines.zh: 擦过我的肩膀，你的手冻僵。
lines.en: Brushing my shoulder leaves your hand numb.
Don't walk through the shadow.

lines.zh: 那边的路不是你走的那条。
lines.en: That path isn't the one you came by.
Your hand touched the wall.
A mark remained on the wall.
Not yours.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起的时候，灯灭了。
lines.en: When we collided, the lights went out.

lines.zh: 现在你还在原来的地方吗？
lines.en: Are you still where you were?

lines.zh: 这个名字不是给这种事用的。
lines.en: That name isn't for such things.

lines.zh: 这样的夜里，我不需要同伴。
lines.en: On a night like this I need no companion.

lines.zh: 这条走廊里只有我一个人。
lines.en: I'm alone in this corridor.
You may leave.
The voices keep me company.
They're more obedient than people.
Don't stand in the doorway watching.
The door will close.
I don't plan to keep you.
Nothing living stays here.
It fell to the floor. I picked it up.

lines.zh: 这东西在这儿不属于任何东西。
lines.en: Nothing here owns this.
Yours?
Not anymore.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，又轻轻放回去。
lines.en: I pick it up and set it gently back.
It looks too clean.
I held it and it went cold.
You'd better not touch it.
It will remember your hand.
Everything here remembers.
You're at the far end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 你还没看见我，我已经笑了。
lines.en: You have not seen me, and I am already smiling.
The lights are going out one by one.
Starting from my end.
You don't need to run.

lines.zh: 这条走廊只有一个方向。
lines.en: This corridor goes one way.
My name gets there first.
It will ring in your ears.
Then we begin.

lines.zh: 我的名字，是从别人那里借的。
lines.en: My name is borrowed from someone else.
My shadow stretches with me.
The wall is right behind you.
Behind the wall is more corridor.
You thought that was a door.
That isn't a door.
There's no way back now.

lines.zh: 苍白的手指，一直悬在你肩后。
lines.en: Pale fingers hover just behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快也在走廊里。
lines.en: Run as fast as you like. You're still in the corridor.
Half the lights are out now.
I'm counting the rest.

lines.zh: 你回头那次，我就在树后。
lines.en: When you looked back, I was behind the tree.
The second time will be closer.
One extra pair of footsteps.
Mine isn't either of them.
The cracks follow you.
Do you hear the whispering?
It's my name pronouncing yours.
You turned a corner.

lines.zh: 这条路刚才不是这样的。
lines.en: This path wasn't like this before.

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑自己的记忆。
lines.en: You're starting to doubt your memory.
Good.

lines.zh: 灯已经灭到一半，我在数剩下的。
lines.en: Half the lamps are out; I am counting the rest.
Stopping won't help.

lines.zh: 你的第七步，落在了我旁边。
lines.en: On your seventh step, you land beside me.
One thousand and one.
Don't stop.
I never touched you, yet you fall.

lines.zh: 你却觉得有人掐住喉咙。
lines.en: Yet you feel a grip on your throat.
All the lights are out.
Now there's only sound.
Your name was said once.
Something left you.
I can't see you, but I hear you.
I tilt my head at you sitting on the ground.
The floor is cold.
Don't look up.
I said it again.
Closer this time.

lines.zh: 你想不起自己的名字了。
lines.en: You can't recall your own name.
The moonlight on your face is good.
Then use mine.
Do you hear the laughter?
I appear at the end of the corridor.
Not by walking.
The light chose that moment to flicker.
And there you were.

lines.zh: 这个名字先到，然后是我。
lines.en: The name arrived first. Then me.

lines.zh: 这条走廊本来就属于我。
lines.en: This corridor was always mine.
You can try walking back.
Go on ahead; I will follow behind.
Your shadow moved first.
It's more honest than I am.
Stand there and look at me.
Say my name again.
The lights here know me.
They give way one by one.
That sound you heard.
It came out of the wall.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后，没有声音。
lines.en: I stand behind you without a sound.
Yet you know I'm approaching.
Your name is in my mouth.
I keep to this lamp.

lines.zh: 火在这条走廊里烧得没有影子。
lines.en: Fire burns without shadow in this corridor.

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我却停住了。
lines.en: There was no floor, yet I stopped.

lines.zh: 水从墙里渗出来，我沉了下去。
lines.en: Water seeped from the walls and I sank.

lines.zh: 爆炸之后，走廊短了一截。
lines.en: After the blast, the corridor was shorter.

lines.zh: 你的箭穿过我，扎在后面的墙上。
lines.en: Your arrow passed through me into the wall.

lines.zh: 一道光照进来，我的轮廓淡了。
lines.en: Light came in, and my outline faded.
My belly is empty, yet I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 雷声把灯管全都震碎了。
lines.en: The thunder shattered every light.
There isn't even a corridor here.
